finding: The interval candidate had lower measured isolated-dispatch median latency in both observed batches. This is not normal-frame FPS, live integration or an accepted gameplay optimization.

protocol.per_batch_schedule: Two original warmups, two candidate warmups, then ABBA repeated four times; A original, B candidate.

oracle_after_every_target_dispatch.source: Pinned complete profile-02 original baseline outputs

protocol.untimed_warmup_timestamp_fields: Zero placeholders; no timestamp queries were recorded for warmups.

descriptive_statistics_method: Median, minimum and maximum of all eight saved timed nanosecond values per module per batch, divided by 1000000. No filtering; warmups were untimed by the fixed protocol. No confidence interval or population/general-performance inference.

background_activity.known_process_scan: No matching known game/helper executable was observed before either batch.
background_activity.exclusive_lease_coordination: Parent granted each bounded batch separately; both leases released after terminal completion.
background_activity.limitation: The known-process scan is not proof that all GPU background activity was excluded.

limitations: Measurements surround a dispatch, not shader arithmetic alone: pipeline/driver state emitted for the dispatch may fall inside the GPU bracket.
Compilation, shader-cache setup, CPU resets, complete CPU oracle checks and final file hashes are outside measured intervals.
CPU full-oracle/reset gaps can affect subsequent GPU clock/cache state; no locked-clock or equivalent device-state claim is made.
All samples and outliers are retained. The candidate has a lower latency cluster in batch 1 and a higher outlier in batch 2; these are observations, not assigned causes.

Both complete byte checks and two unfiltered batches support this fixed owned-graph observation only; general equivalence, live renderer integration, visual/native quality and accepted gameplay optimization remain unproved.
Historical live CPU atomicity and original complete device/float-state equivalence remain separate.
No normal-frame FPS or whole-game speedup was measured.
frozen_artifact_policy: Profile 02, original timing CPU freeze, source, helper, plans, preparation metadata/docs and both runtime batches are preserved unchanged.
pipeline_executable_statistics_scope: Driver compiler metadata retained separately from timestamp durations. Cycles is an estimate; zero reported GRF registers does not establish zero physical register usage.
